notes.title: New market
notes.content: [p]Lately I have mostly worked on the online tournament mode (coming soon) and an in-engine map editor to improve the map creation/editon workflow. [/p][p]Armada is currently working hard to improve the maps. He's revamping the Coconut Market from scratch. While the map is still a Work In Progress, it is ready for testing. [/p][p]So here is a small update before testing the tournament mode.[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]** bugfixes **[/u][/b][/p][p]- fix occasional lag on first kill [/p][p]- fix a rare & random crash on game startup[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]** gameplay changes **[/u][/b][/p][p]- jetpack: will activate if still holding the jump key after a jump[/p][p]- axe: revert hitbox reduction a bit[/p][p]- rocket aoe damage : 100 => 90 (avoid one shot in the head when helmets) [/p][p]- dashing will get rid of the player on top of us[/p][p]- watermelon: whatever weapon used, it will hit at 100 damage, damage score is now hidden (confusing with player hit)[/p][p]- bots will auto destroy when stuck for some time[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]** quality of life **[/u][/b][/p][p]- the FOV is now ajustable in the settings[/p][p]- automatic reconnection to server after an unwanted disconnection (when unstable internet)[/p][p]- you can now play in the lobby[/p][p]- retrieve chat history on server connection [/p][p]- remove region select popup[/p][p][/p][p][b][u]** UI changes **[/u][/b] [/p][p]- replaced oxygen bar[/p][p]- bigger text in split screen[/p][p]- player list: added scroll bar (not yet clickable but with mouse wheel)[/p]

notes.title: Split screen & gameplay improvements & fixing stuff
notes.content:
Since the game was played by a lot of new people during Gamers Assembly and after, a lot of bugs and issues were discovered.  I improved a lot of stuff for a better first experience with the game and also fixed some exploits & problems found by more experienced players.  
Special thanks to mirtonze for his in-depth bug hunting.

[u][b]** bugfixes **[/b][/u]

- crash fix on menu if 'mouse prev' was clicked in the same frame than play.
- fix player going through the roof when climbing a watermelon in a cave.
- fix some buttons activation behaviour 

[u][b]** weapons changes **[/b][/u]

- dagger: damage x2 when dashing
- dagger: fast shot damage ~x2  (almost as worth as the fullcharged shot)

- arrow: fast shot damage ~x2  (almost as worth as the fullcharged shot)
- arrow: takes player velocity into account

- axe: reduce hitbox

- coconuts: takes player velocity into account
- coconut: add small AOE damage (25)
- fire coconut: add AOE damage (50)
- explosive coconut: AOE damage 75 => 100

- weapons not allowed when walking on map border rocks
- brush: can't break armors

[u][b]** gameplay changes **[/b][/u]

- watermelon: can dash with it
- watermelon: better control
- watermelon: explode in the hit direction (when hit close)
- watermelon slice: a bit more bouncy

- jetpack: keep the double jump
- jetpack: duration reduced from 4s to 3s
- jetpack: start half loaded (instead of empty)

- invincibility : 3 sec => 2.3sec
- infinity dash unlock only at level 8

- water: add 5sec oxygen gauge (fix hiding in underwater caves forever)
- lava: add small protection health bar before it remove health points  

- when only two people are left: we can now see the player tag behind walls. 
- when only two people are left: high tension auto kill is disabled

- players can climb on each others

[u][b]** quality of life **[/b][/u]

- controls: need to hold the respawn key for 0.5sec to be activated (avoid unintentionnal respawn) 
- controls: gamepad: use back button for score table
- controls: gamepad: the brush is now selectable 
- controls: allow free cam usage in training mode
- controls: can use space bar instead of clicking on 'ok' / 'skip'

- options: fps counter: average/min/max mode
- options: add vsync option
- options: add mouse invert y 

- lobby menu: max bot count 7 => 14 (may be instable on bad net connections)
- lobby menu: limit team count to 8
- lobby menu: show remove bot grayed out instead of disappearing
- lobby menu: show a warning when team player count is unbalanced and auto balanced is activated
- lobby menu: admin can kick/ban players

- UI: show player life count in HUD
- UI: spectating mode: remove the top black bar (was hidding stuff like high tension)
- UI: always show the current player name on screen (even in respawn)
- UI: high tension warning is shown earlier
- UI: avoid 'are you sure you want to give up' popup when the tournament is finished. 
- UI: score table: best hit distance is now only for kill, not hits.

- music: the game remember the last song played so it avoid always starting with the same one.
- hide the console on windows 11 
- using windows Documents folder instead of obscure steam hidden folder for players data

[u][b]** split screen **[/b][/u]

- add Split Screen support (was in beta branch for gamers assembly)
- fix cursor appear position (now in middle of player screen region)
- fix players tag not showing
- player 1 is not forced to play with mouse/keyboard 
- score table is shown per player
- smaller font (may be too small..)
- option window in big

[u][b]** other **[/b][/u]

- automatic game mode: bow is now before axe, and is the default mode (and used in campaign)
- add small delay on some notifications (gain life / multikills)
- rename 4/5 kills streaks achievement 
- improve lava transition rendering effect
- changed first jump sound
- working on a replay editor (not ready yet)

[u][b]** known major bugs / will fix later ** [/b][/u]

- you can dash into stuff and get stuck
- you can go under the map and shoot from outside the walls

notes.title: Sea trampolines Update
notes.content:
Hey! small update to announce a new map and more:

While I would love to see tryharders compete on this game, I think I should focus on the 'fun' instead. 
So I made a new map to reflect that choice. 

I also implemented controler support (only xbox for now) to allow casual players to play.

jump 1.75 => 2 meters

notes.title: Boiling Water & News
notes.content:
Hey! This a small update before the next playtest but I wanted to give some news.

Not sure I should talk about it here but I could not work for two months due to severe health issue (type A aortic dissection). 

I was working toward an itch.io demo that I will release asap. 
I hope to find some new players there that could join the next playtest. (26 of January).

notes.title: Dynamic Enviromments
notes.content:
The biggest change in this update is the introduction of the 'floor is lava' & 'water rising' modifiers.

[u][b]Floor is lava[/b][/u]

The floor can turn to lave anytime during the match, the total lava duration is a parameter that can be tweaked for each game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028665/de0f4adc679c023c588e8169f0a85bcc990208da.png[/img]

[u][b]Water rising[/b][/u]

If enabled, the water level will rise progressively to a max altitude and stay there a moment, then decrease to the initial level. Then the next cycle starts etc.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45028665/e456c57007bd653637dcace8a76265ffb572f387.png[/img]

-----
Those features are not available with bots.

[u][b]Other notable changes[/b][/u]

- There are special spawns for the start of the game, to jump directly into the knife fight
- I have reworked all interfaces
- every region can access server from other regions (the limit is just by ping)
- easier mode for bots 
- changed double jump physics (more powerful on fast press, can reach the same height with fast or slow press)

[u][b] Misc changes[/b][/u]

- show total damage score at end game
- better perfs
- training mode: can level up, added protection to targets
- exe is signed (should remove antivirus warning)

notes.title: Play against Bots
notes.content:
Hi !  

This update is focused on bug fixing and responding to player requests made on my discord.

The main novelty is you can now [b]play with bots [/b] offline.  

I also improved the [b]damage awareness[/b], we were too often shot from behind without being aware. 
I finished implementing [b]remappable controls[/b].

Here is the complete change list:


[b]---------- BUG FIXES ---------- [/b]

move from spectator list to player list automatically when late joined
fix player names visibility 
disable jump on projectiles (fix double jump reset when self-shoot on feet) => infinite fly glitch
projectile vs projectile collision: keep both projectile alive (instead of one of them randomly destroyed) 
projectile vs projectile collision: fix weird coconut flying slowly (activate gravity) 
fix weapon clipping in walls
patched a hole in arena
coconut gun: fix reload animation (wait for cooldown end before reload)

[b]----------  GAMEPLAY CHANGES ----------[/b]

coconut gun: reload time 1,5 sec => 2sec (+ the skipped cooldown)
the trampoline bounce activate the one-shot 1000 damage effect
arena: added deadly spikes at some places 
add a crown to the game leader (if he has more life than all others)


[b]---------- MINOR CHANGES ----------[/b]

hit distance: compute traveled projectile distance instead of length(firing point-hit point) 
added an FX for the one-shot enabled projectiles. (20m+ axe, or trampoline bounced projectiles)
soundsteps can be heard from further
added sound effect for barrel & helmet break.
jump icon: grayed out if cannot jump
background blur effect on respawn menu
other minor stuff I forgot

notes.title: Implemented remappable keys
notes.content:
You can now reassign movement & actions keys in the options menu.

Limitations:
- You can't reassign the mouse buttons right now
- The UI is not yet taking into account the remapping.
- The bindings editor shows the QWERTY input, so it can show wrong letters in AZERTY.

I will address this issues later.
